source_protocol.learning: Shared retains one KnowledgeLibrary per sequence; cold starts a new library per task. Both retain within-task prior revision. Task and evaluation seeds are identical across arms.
source_protocol.evaluation_timing: All 24 learning tasks must finish before independent measurements or GP training are requested. No evaluation observations return to the library.
source_protocol.accounting: Actual simulator calls are counted. Each frozen model uses 128 primary evaluation calls, 8 new GP training calls and 64 GP evaluation calls. The three GP models share identical newly acquired data, rather than reacquiring it three times.
source_protocol.scope: Two finite noise-free RZDT constraint families at dimension five. Public simulate outputs only; this evaluates hypothesis discovery and cross-project consumption, not optimization improvement or the current SC-KG paper method.

protocol.task_selection: RZDT2 at position 1 of each source cohort; acquire new full vector records under the same frozen research protocol
protocol.accounting: Each data-reuse arm pays for the whole Hegel research history once, initializes the real SC-KG GP/HVD with every recorded objective/constraint observation, and spends the remaining calls on original SC-KG acquisition. The default-cold arm gets 64 original SC-KG calls. The two data-reuse arms share identical acquired research data; their per-arm totals each include that source cost.
protocol.evaluation: Original SC-KG post-run truth scoring only, after all acquisition and the final recommendation have frozen. No truth values reconstruct missing research outputs.
protocol.scope: Three-seed bounded optimizer comparison; the prior program-only negative baseline is retained.
